name: ScientistTwo: End-to-End Research, Writing, and Review Workflow

main.instructions: Run the complete ScientistTwo workflow using the scienceevolve-scientist-two Skill. Read the protocol and role contracts first. In the Task workspace, run scripts/protocol.py init only once, then run next. Dispatch the current ticket, role, cropped context, and required output fields to the single designated workflow agent; Main must not make scientific judgments. After the worker finishes, validate its files, submit its response, and route according to the next result. Finish only when role is empty. For blocked work, resolve the actual environment, data, or tool issue and resume the same role; do not skip stages or change budgets. Preserve script and SDK state for resumption; never reinitialize existing state. no_successful_idea is a valid scientific failure outcome and must not produce a paper. For other outcomes, export the complete package, select the deliverable with select_display, then call complete_project and report the exact outcome. Budgets: 3 initial candidates, seed pool of 6, 4 total rounds, then 1 evolved idea plus 1 seed, and S=4; see the protocol for remaining limits. Do not modify the workflow or run the entire upstream autonomous system as a tool.

task_setup.instructions:
Build the Task from the request and actual source materials. Capture the scientific question; original SOTA paper, code, and full results; fixed representative subset; all datasets, metric directions, and statistical methods; permitted changes; execution commands and resources; Google Search and Semantic Scholar availability; literature cutoff; and the shared novelty rubric. Confirm data, runtime, search, LaTeX, and PDF visual-inspection tools are available. Freeze the benchmark, subset, and constraints; never change the test set to improve scores. Include all protocol-required Task fields and report any replacement of the paper's original model. Return blocked if required conditions are missing.
